name: RYOBI
legalEntityNote: Ryobi Limited owns the RYOBI trademark. Techtronic Industries uses it under licence for power tools and outdoor equipment in specified regions, while KYOCERA Industrial Tools succeeded to Ryobi Limited's former power-tool operation. Brand owner, licensee, seller and manufacturer are not interchangeable.
headline: RYOBI ownership, TTI licensing, Kyocera boundary and cleaning equipment

ownership.summary: Ryobi Limited, a Tokyo Stock Exchange-listed Japanese company, owns the RYOBI trademark. TTI states that it uses RYOBI under licence and manufactures and distributes RYOBI power tools and lawn-and-garden equipment in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia and New Zealand. Kyocera acquired Ryobi Limited's former power-tool business in 2018 and operates a separate route through KYOCERA Industrial Tools.
ownership.parentCompany: Ryobi Limited is the independent public trademark owner

productPortfolio.name: Cordless vacuums and floorcare
productPortfolio.positioning: Hand vacuums, stick vacuums, scrubbers and carpet-care tools extend the battery platform into home and workshop cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm voltage platform, included battery, accessories, floor suitability and local warranty by exact regional SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Wet-dry vacuums and jobsite cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: Portable and higher-capacity wet-dry vacuums serve workshops, vehicles, jobsites and professional cleanup.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Filtration, tank size, hose system, electrical rating and parts availability vary across models.

productPortfolio.name: Pressure washers and outdoor cleaning
productPortfolio.positioning: Pressure washers, power cleaners and related accessories connect the brand's tool platform to exterior cleaning.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify manufacturer, compliance, fittings, accessories, service entity and territorial licence for the destination market.

productPortfolio.name: Outdoor power equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Mowers, trimmers, blowers and other lawn equipment form a major licensed RYOBI ecosystem in TTI-served regions.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: The visible brand does not prove the same licensee, specification or battery system applies worldwide.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: TTI's annual report states that RYOBI is a Ryobi Limited trademark used under licence rather than a TTI-owned mark.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the regional licensee and product company before mapping manufacturing responsibility.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Ryobi Limited's 2018 notice says TTI would continue to manufacture and distribute RYOBI power tools and lawn-and-garden equipment in five named regions.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not extend the TTI route to countries or product categories not covered by the relevant agreement.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: KYOCERA Industrial Tools succeeded to the former Ryobi Limited power-tool business and now operates its own brand and product route.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm whether a product belongs to the TTI-licensed route, Kyocera route or another authorized regional arrangement.

marketsChannels.evidence: TTI distributes RYOBI power tools and outdoor equipment in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia and New Zealand.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the local website, packaging, invoice and warranty terms to identify the responsible TTI entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: RYOBI is positioned through mass retail, ecommerce and service networks connected to TTI's regional channel strategy.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm seller authorization, gray-market restrictions, parts and warranty coverage.

marketsChannels.evidence: Kyocera markets power tools through a separate business inherited from Ryobi Limited.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Do not assume products from the Kyocera route share specifications, batteries or warranty with TTI-served RYOBI products.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: RYOBI benefits from high consumer recognition and a broad battery ecosystem that can carry cleaning products beside tools and lawn equipment. Its main diligence risk is geographic and legal ambiguity: the trademark owner, TTI licensee, Kyocera successor business, manufacturer, seller and warranty provider can be different parties.

developments.title: TTI confirms the RYOBI licence in its annual report
developments.summary: TTI continues to distinguish the licensed RYOBI trademark from the brands it owns.

developments.title: Ryobi Limited transfers its power-tool operation
developments.summary: Kyocera acquired the former operating business while Ryobi Limited retained the trademark and TTI continued its named regional licence.

developments.title: Ryobi Limited is founded
developments.summary: The Japanese company began as Ryobi Seisakusho and later expanded across several industrial businesses.
